summary.key_theme: IBM 憑藉量子運算技術突破與主機架構創新維持長期成長動能，儘管面臨部分業務營收波動與市場估值挑戰。

bullish.title: IBM Unveils First Dual‑Architecture Mainframe Processor To Support IBM And Arm Platforms
bullish.reason: 推出首款雙架構主機處理器，整合 Arm 架構將顯著擴大 IBM Z 與 LinuxONE 系統的軟體生態系與應用場景。

bullish.title: IBM Announces Successful Joining And Cooling Down Of Two Cryogenic Modules
bullish.reason: 量子運算冷卻技術的里程碑，為 2029 年實現 Quantum Starling 系統奠定關鍵硬體基礎，展現長期技術領先地位。

bullish.title: Why Is IBM (IBM) Up 13.1% Since Last Earnings Report?
bullish.reason: 財報後股價強勢上漲 13.1%，顯示市場對其轉型策略與獲利能力的認可。

bullish.title: TD SYNNEX (SNX) Expands IBM Footprint
bullish.reason: 合作夥伴擴大經銷版圖至 20 個新地區，有助於提升 IBM 軟體與硬體產品的市場滲透率。

bullish.title: Does NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA)’s AI Dominance Leave Any Room for International Business (IBM) to Catch Up?
bullish.reason: 報導提及 2.4 億美元的多年度合約，顯示 IBM 在 AI 領域仍具備穩定的企業級客戶基礎。

bullish.title: IBM: Big Blue Sees Red Hat; Mainframe Headwinds, Software Tailwinds
bullish.reason: 分析師維持買入評級，認為軟體業務的成長足以抵銷主機業務的短期逆風。

bearish.title: IBM Stock Is Out Of Favor, But The Margin Commitment Never Came Down
bearish.reason: 第二季財報營收未達預期且下調營收指引，儘管維持利潤承諾，但市場對其成長動能仍存疑。

bearish.title: IBM vs. Accenture: One Trades at a 52-Week Low. The Better Dividend Stock May Surprise You.
bearish.reason: 與同業 Accenture 相比，財務指標與估值吸引力較弱，可能導致資金流向競爭對手。

bearish.title: Is International Business Machines (IBM) Reasonable After A 115% Run?
bearish.reason: 過去五年股價漲幅達 115%，市場擔憂估值過高，可能面臨獲利回吐壓力。

bearish.title: Circle Internet shares surge after acquisition of IBM blockchain patent portfolio
bearish.reason: 出售區塊鏈專利組合雖能變現，但也暗示 IBM 縮減在該領域的直接投入。

neutral.title: IBM Just Hit a New Quantum Computing Milestone. How to Play IBM Stock Now.
neutral.reason: 綜合報導量子技術進展與投資策略，未提供新的基本面資訊，僅為市場觀點彙整。

neutral.title: Can IBM Scale Quantum Computing With Its New Cryogenic Systems?
neutral.reason: 探討量子運算擴展的可行性，屬於技術層面的深度分析，對短期股價影響有限。

neutral.title: Wall Street Lunch: IBM Advances Quantum Roadmap By Connecting Two Cryogenic Modules
neutral.reason: 重複報導量子模組連接進展，屬於新聞快訊性質，影響力已在相關報導中反映。
